mentions.name: subedit
mentions.description: An AI-native linter and formatter that automatically fixes the style of AI-generated code comments and Markdown, and falls back to asking AI via a hook to regenerate content when misalignment cannot be corrected deterministically.
mentions.problem: AI-generated code comments or Markdown usually doesn't match the author's preferred style.
mentions.source_excerpt: AI-generated code comments or Markdown usually isn't my style, so I built an AI-native linter and formatter, which automatically fixes the style or asks AI via a hook to regenerate if something is misaligned but cannot be reformatted deterministically.

evidence.value: AI-generated code comments or Markdown usually isn't my style, so I built an AI-native linter and formatter, which automatically fixes the style or asks AI via a hook to regenerate if something is misaligned but cannot be reformatted deterministically.
